title: Electric field strength
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the electric field strength E = W / (e * d_AB) to obtain 2500 V/m.

title: Potential difference U_CD
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the potential difference between C and D using U_CD = E * CD * cos(60°) to obtain 100 V.

title: Potential at point C
description: Essential: Correctly determines the electric potential at C relative to grounded plate B, finding φ_C = E * d_CB = 200 V.

title: Potential energy at C
description: Essential: Correctly computes the proton's electric potential energy at C using E_pC = e * φ_C to obtain 3.2e-17 J.

title: Work-potential difference relation
description: Important: Applies the relationship W = q * U for work done by the electric field, connecting it to field strength.

title: Correct distance projection
description: Important: Uses the component of the displacement along the field (CD * cosθ) when calculating U_CD.

title: Reference potential setup
description: Important: Correctly handles the grounding of plate B (setting φ_B = 0) to find the potential at C.

title: Sign error in work/energy
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns sign to work, potential difference, or potential energy for the positive proton.

title: Unit conversion mistake
description: Pitfall: Fails to convert distances from cm to meters, leading to incorrect numerical results.

title: Distance misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Uses the straight-line distance CD without the cosine factor, or uses the wrong distance for d_CB.
